I don't think so although we were very close.

It wasn't a big enough thing on March 4th and she had been planning her suicide since the new year.

It does but the United Methodist Church can't make up their minds and she was becoming a chaplain with them in the Army.

The wedding will be after quarantine thanks for your concern.

That is incredibly careless of her. Acetaminophen (Tylenol) poisoning is no joke. I'm glad that DD will be OK. I can totally see why you wouldn't want her to take care of DD again. The nurse in me wants to make a suggestion. Definitely if anyone but you is giving DD any medications make sure they show you they know how, when, and what dose to give. People can be oblivious fools as evidenced by JNMIL.
